message.reasoning:
I need to respond to a Monopoly trade offer.

I'm evaluating the offer to trade New York Avenue for $400. I have four properties and no monopolies. The opponent already holds St. James Place and Tennessee Avenue, so New York Avenue would complete their orange monopoly. I've consistently rejected trades involving this property.

The opponent would have $686 left after the trade. That is enough to build houses on their orange monopoly immediately. New York Avenue with three houses would charge $750 in rent, and a hotel would charge $1000. I will reject this offer.

I considered counter-offering, but any deal that still hands New York Avenue to the opponent would be unwise. The orange monopoly is worth far more than $400, and the opponent could bankrupt me with those rents. I am now checking what properties the opponent currently holds to see if a different counter makes sense.

The opponent currently holds St. James Place, Tennessee Avenue, Water Works, Short Line, Vermont, and Connecticut. A counter asking for St. James and Tennessee plus cash would give me the orange monopoly, but it would not address their actual interest in New York Avenue. The counter_trade tool replaces the current offer entirely.

The opponent cannot afford three houses on the orange set. Two houses on each property would cost $600, leaving them with only $86 to build. I am now recalling the exact rent values for that configuration.
